title: Tulī Takes Flight Scholarships 2026
provider: Ministry of Education / Pacific Education Foundation
degree_levels: Vocational, Undergraduate, Graduate, Postgraduate up to Doctoral
eligibility_summary: Pacific peoples seeking to reduce financial barriers towards study or training in Aotearoa New Zealand. Open for vocational or degree-level study.
funding_details: Up to NZD $32,000 per scholarship for the 2026 round.

title: Pacific Education Foundation Scholarships 2026
provider: Ministry of Education / Pacific Education Foundation
eligibility_summary: Pacific students in any field of study. 12 scholarships available for 2026.
funding_details: NZD $5,400 grant for full-time undergraduate study; NZD $10,400 grant for full-time postgraduate study.

title: New Zealand Space Scholarship 2026
provider: Ministry of Business, Innovation & Employment / New Zealand Space Agency
eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens enrolled in a postgraduate degree in science, technology, engineering or mathematics at a New Zealand tertiary institution in 2026, with an interest in space and advanced aviation.
funding_details: Return economy airfares to the United States, accommodation costs, a living allowance, and travel/medical insurance.
duration: 3 months (NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory internship, June–September 2026)

title: Tāwhia te Mana Research Fellowships 2026 — Mana Tūāpapa Future Leader Fellowship
provider: Royal Society Te Apārangi / Ministry of Business, Innovation & Employment
eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents with a PhD conferred within 4 years of the closing date (on or after 9 July 2022), supported by a New Zealand-based research organisation. Must not have previously been awarded a major research grant as Principal Investigator.
funding_details: Total value NZD $820,000 over 4 years (0.8 FTE basis). Includes salary, research expenses, and overheads. Up to ~$35,000 per year for postgraduate scholarships plus fees.

title: Tāwhia te Mana Research Fellowships 2026 — Mana Tūānuku Research Leader Fellowship
provider: Royal Society Te Apārangi / Ministry of Business, Innovation & Employment
eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents with a PhD conferred more than 4 years and less than 12 years before the closing date (on or after 9 July 2014 and before 9 July 2022), supported by a New Zealand-based research organisation.
funding_details: Approximately 10 fellowships awarded annually. Funding covers salary, research expenses, and overheads at the host organisation's rate.

title: Tāwhia te Mana Research Fellowships 2026 — Mana Tūārangi Distinguished Researcher Fellowship
provider: Royal Society Te Apārangi / Ministry of Business, Innovation & Employment
eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents with a PhD, supported by a New Zealand-based research organisation. 2026 round focus: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technologies. Expansive international and transdisciplinary reputation required.
funding_details: Total value NZD $220,000 over 1–2 years. Up to NZD $100,000 per year for salary contribution; remainder for research-related expenses.

title: Rhodes Scholarship for New Zealand 2026
provider: Rhodes Trust / Universities New Zealand — Te Pōkai Tara
eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents who have spent at least 5 of the previous 10 years in NZ. Must be 18–24 on 1 October 2026 (or up to 27 if first undergraduate degree completed after 1 October 2025). Academic excellence required.
funding_details: Full funding for study at the University of Oxford (University and College fees, stipend, travel, and other allowances).

title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships 2027 (Tertiary)
provider: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (MFAT) / Education New Zealand
eligibility_summary: Citizens of eligible partner countries (Pacific, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, Latin America, Caribbean — 80+ countries). Full-time on-campus study in New Zealand. Priority given to subjects meeting home-country development needs.
funding_details: Full tuition fees, NZD $615 per week living allowance, NZD $3,000 establishment allowance, medical insurance, tutoring costs up to NZD $1,000, return airfare, and NZD $1,000 reintegration allowance.
duration: Varies by programme (typically 1–4 years for degree study)

title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships — Samoa Foundation 2026
provider: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (MFAT) / Education New Zealand
eligibility_summary: Citizens of Samoa. Tertiary study at a New Zealand education institution.
funding_details: Full scholarship covering tuition, living allowance, and related costs.

title: Ngarimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarships 2026–2027
provider: Ministry of Education / Ngarimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarship Fund Board
eligibility_summary: Māori students pursuing vocational or tertiary study at university, wānanga, or in vocational education and training. Values aligned with the 28th Māori Battalion.
funding_details: 5 × VET scholarships at NZD $10,000 each; 4 × undergraduate scholarships up to NZD $30,000 ($10,000/year for up to 3 years); 3 × master's scholarships up to NZD $20,000 ($10,000/year for up to 2 years); 1 × Master of Education research scholarship up to NZD $20,000; 1 × doctoral scholarship up to NZD $40,000 ($20,000/year for up to 2 years).
duration: Up to 3 years (undergraduate); up to 2 years (master's); up to 2 years (doctoral)

title: Kupe Scholarship for Māori and Pacific High Achievers 2027
degree_levels: Undergraduate, Graduate Diploma in Teaching, Master of Teaching
eligibility_summary: Māori or Pacific descent, New Zealand citizen, permanent resident or resident visa holder. Must have completed at least one full year of an approved teaching course or be enrolled in an approved Graduate Diploma/Master of Teaching with academic excellence (B+ average or above for undergraduates).
funding_details: Course fees for approved teaching qualification plus a NZD $15,000 allowance over the period of study (limited to 3 years). Includes a Kupe Keepsake and leadership development/mentoring.

title: University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship 2027
eligibility_summary: School leavers planning to start undergraduate study at the University of Auckland in 2027. Academic achievement and potential.
funding_details: Up to NZD $27,000 total: one year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence plus NZD $5,000.

title: University of Auckland Vaka Moana Scholarship 2027
eligibility_summary: Pacific students commencing first-year undergraduate study at the University of Auckland in 2027.
funding_details: Up to NZD $24,000: one year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence plus a laptop.

title: University of Waikato Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship 2026
application_deadline: 30 November 2025 (A Trimester); 30 April 2026 (B Trimester); 31 August 2026 (C Trimester); 31 October 2026 (H or X Trimester)
eligibility_summary: International students (excluding those eligible for specific regional scholarships) with an Offer of Place from the University of Waikato. Academic merit and potential to become global ambassadors.
funding_details: Up to NZD $15,000 for undergraduate study; up to NZD $10,000 for postgraduate study. Paid as a credit towards tuition fees.

title: University of Otago Vice-Chancellor's International Postgraduate Scholarships
eligibility_summary: International students commencing selected full-time postgraduate programmes at the University of Otago. Not citizens, permanent residents or resident visa holders of New Zealand or Australia. Minimum NZ B+ equivalent.
funding_details: NZD $10,000 contribution towards tuition fees for full-time study (12 months).

title: University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship
eligibility_summary: International students obtaining their first Master's qualification and undertaking a thesis-based Master's at the University of Otago. Academic merit and research potential.
funding_details: NZD $18,204 stipend per annum plus tuition fee waiver for 1 year (capped at NZD $35,000 for thesis component).
